name: Goldmark
summary: A personal investments tracker in PKR: gold by tola, shares, funds, certificates, goals and a Zakat estimate
about: A nine-page money dashboard for a saver in Lahore, in deep green and gold. A gold bar fills with liquid gold to show how much of everything you own is gold, and the allocation donut has gold knobs you drag to set a target mix while the legend works out what to buy or sell. Live demo prices tick by tola and karat, and the portfolio, transactions, dividends, goals planner, Zakat estimate with nisab, reports and settings all work and keep their data in the browser.
how: Open a page from the top bar: Overview, Portfolio, Transactions, Dividends, Goals, Gold, Zakat or Reports; Settings is behind your initials
On Overview switch Your mix to Target and drag the gold knobs on the donut; the legend shows what to buy or sell, then press Save target
Add a transaction or a holding: buys come out of the savings account and sales, dividends and rent go back into it
On Gold watch the rates per tola move, try the calculator, set a price alert and slide If gold moves to see the gold bar change
On Zakat pick the silver or gold nisab, switch lines on or off, add debts and record payments; the estimate updates as you go
Move the sliders on a goal to see when you reach it, and mark payouts as received on Dividends
Press Ctrl+K to jump anywhere, the eye to hide amounts, and reset the demo data in Settings
